title: Eigenvalues of the product matrices of finite commutative rings
summary: The product matrix of a finite commutative ring $R=\{x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\}$ and an element $u \in R$ is the matrix $A_u(R)=[a_{ij}]$, where $a_{ij}=1$ if $x_ix_j=u$, and $a_{ij}=0$ otherwise. This provides a natural extension of the concept of the adjacency matrix of the zero-divisor graph of a ring, which has been studied extensively. In this paper, we find the characteristic polynomial of $A_u(R)$ for a local ring $R$ of odd order and a unit $u$.
